Remark
[The method of a priori estimates] ↗ thm:schaefers-fixed-point-theorem 1. ch9:9.2.2-rem-1\group Fixed Point Theorems

Bounding every solution of $u=\lambda A[u]$ uniformly for $0\leq \lambda \leq 1$ yields a fixed point of $A$. This is the method of a priori estimates.
